Solve which separate surfaces the part is meant to touch before selecting a spacer length.

bounded_sequence.concrete_result: Each own observable source and review. Use both end support footprints; preserve separate seal lips and speedometer path. Hidden bearings/internal collar act as separately labelled interface context until visible or required, no fake precision from bearing code.

bounded_sequence.concrete_result: Panel shaft axis stays coaxial with wheel; examine ring overlap, shoulders and sparse anchors plus actual surfaces at all useful azimuths. bounded_sequence.concrete_result: Related JA131606 bush, seal/washer/stopper and cable exit stay separate. D04 item12 gear meter screw is not replaced by a cable stuck into a solid face. Internal gear ratio and exact drive engagement remain unknown. Attach actual current lot12 speedometer cable only after exit position/orientation are declared estimates and checked through steering motion.

bounded_sequence.piece_or_action: Brake cam, existing cam lever and cable termination
bounded_sequence.concrete_result: Move existing isolated lever from its own origin to the actual panel cam-hole frame by rigid transform, not vertex scaling. Check actual cam-hole/lever seat, cable eye, cable sheath stop and reaction. Create pinch hardware only after the lever interface exists. The current lever build subtracts shaft bore, cable eye and slot only; it has NO transverse clamp-bolt drill, so a floating M6 bolt/nut cannot be called installed.

bounded_sequence.piece_or_action: One bounded assembly comparison after individual pieces
bounded_sequence.concrete_result: Whole wheel and axial close view, visible shaft retention, gaps/contacts and separate materials; source/export same actual buffers and useful steering/wheel/cable poses. No hidden shoes, free-spinning cam or sparse-ray equality described as functional brake certification.

brake_numeric_preparation.limitation: These are parameter anchors, not new measurements or proof of compatible splines/cam/actuation. Separate pose and frame must be verified in evaluated exported surfaces.

pass_conditions: New part visible whole and in useful close view, with attributed related shape references and estimated dimensions explicit.
No frozen legacy geometry altered to force the artistic stack; transforms and new candidate revisions are additive.
Actual multi-azimuth surface checks for bores/shoulders/rings before claim of local clearance; sparse axial rays alone insufficient.
No floating fastener where a matching aperture or support face is absent.
Spinning wheel, stationary panel/fork, cable sheath anchor and moving cam lever have separate parents/pivots.
Material and GLB proof after shape, then actual game-engine view; no automatic OEM, art or phone qualification.
known_non_goals: Bearing preload, press fits, hydraulic internals or friction performance
Detailed hidden brake mechanism without evidence or visibility requirement
